reviews.title: I can’t believe I haven’t already left a review! Love them!
reviews.comment:
You alone will know why an open ear headset might be something you’d want. So let me just focus on the function of these.
Battery life is epic. I mean all day. I use them all day a lot of the time.
Comfort is excellent. As I said, sometimes I wear them all day. I barely know they are there. In fact, sometimes I forget they are there.
sizing is something we need to talk about. I am 6 feet tall and have a normal sized head I suppose and the mini ones fit me perfectly. I also have short hair so keep that in mind. The reason this is important is because the standard ones might give me a little more freedom without getting tight. I really don’t care about that because the minis allow me to sit in a chair without being uncomfortable when I put my head against the pillow. They can also be used in bed. In fact, sometimes I sleep all night long with these on, and they are still there when I wake up. If you can wear the mini and have a little bit of distance between your neck and head and you don’t have to look up a lot, get the mini! Otherwise get the standard ones and be aware that you probably won’t be able to put the back of your head against anything without removing them.
Yes, you can pull them down and put them around your neck and they will stay there until you are ready to put them back over your ears.
The sound is excellent. Especially once you download the app and boost the base a little. That is the essential feature of these with the extra speakers. However, they work just fine without the extra speakers as long as you were fine with a little treble. Since I normally listen. to podcasts, it doesn’t matter to me. I am just listening to some person‘s voice most of the time. However, if you use them in the classic mode, which means you are just getting the bone conduction, be aware that when you turn it up to a higher volume, you may feel some buzzing on your temples.
I suppose I could look up the IP rating for these. I don’t know what it is. But I’ve worn them in the rain and not had any difficulties.
USB-C charging is clutch!
And I saved the best for last. The microphone call quality and noise, cancellation or voice isolation is really top notch. I mean, handset quality. I really prefer using these for telephone calls over AirPod earphones. These things blocked out a crowing rooster! I mean, wow!
i’ve been using them for a few months and they seem to be pretty durable. No problems. The case that they come in is very nice and they charge quickly. I really don’t have a downside for these except maybe it would be nice to have the microphone extension Like the other model. But then again, the voice quality on these is so good. I don’t think I need it and that would just be something else in the way.
I got these on sale. I don’t know what they cost right now. But if it is within your budget and you are considering them, just hit the buy button because they were great.
reviews.author: Charlie V

reviews.title: Great Sound and Battery Life — Make Sure You Get the Right Head Size
reviews.comment:
⭐ Rating: 5/5
These are amazing overall, but sizing is something you definitely want to pay attention to before ordering.
🔧 What I used it for:
Daily use for music, calls, and general listening around the house and while working.
✅ Pros:
Very comfortable once you get the correct size
Excellent battery life for how compact they are
Bluetooth range is strong — works across the house without dropouts
Good sound quality for everyday listening
Lightweight and easy to wear for long periods
❌ Cons:
Sizing is important — I had to exchange the first set for a smaller size
If the fit is off, comfort and sound isolation will suffer
🧠 Details:
Once I got the correct size, these fit really well and became extremely comfortable even during long listening sessions. Battery life has been impressive considering how small they are — I don’t feel like I’m constantly charging them. Bluetooth connection has also been solid, with no issues moving around the house while staying connected. The main thing to watch out for is getting the correct size from the start, since that makes a big difference in both comfort and performance.
🏁 Final Verdict:
Excellent everyday headphones with great battery life, comfort, and range. Just make sure you measure your head and get the right size the first time — once fitted correctly, they’re fantastic.
reviews.author: Adam

reviews.title: Doesn’t Hurt. Lightweight. Clear Sound.
reviews.comment: Not loud at all which is a good thing. If you’re looking for something to be able to HEAR music (not all the extra bass etc) this is a good product. Lightweight, charges fast, stays on while running. The carrying case is very nice as well. Haven’t used them for a phone call yet.
reviews.author: Brittany Wright

reviews.title: Simply Marvelous
reviews.comment:
Super happy with these. A bit on the pricey side, but totally worth it in the long run. I work 8 hour shifts often listening to music the whole time and on medium volume I can happily report the 14+hr battery to be accurate.
Charges quick and pairs even quicker. Multi device pairing is a breeze too, only being made easier by the app where you can toggle on and off devices that the headphones will try to pair to. So, basically you can pair a bunch of devices and turn the ability to connect to them on and off. For me, I usually pair to my laptop and phone, but have my watch and streaming stick saved and toggled off so the headphones prioritize my phone and laptop so they don't fight for pairing power.
I had the minus volume button deteriorate and come off rendering the rocker almost useless. I reached out to support and they sent me a new pair free of charge since it was still under warranty. Really nice and easy and now I have two pairs, just one I can't turn the volume down on nor rely on its water resistance.
I'd consider myself an average sized dude 5'10" @160lbs and the "mini" size fits perfect and I barely know it's on me until I get a notification and hear it IN STEREO! Stereo audio is also a big plus for me and one of the main downsides to using just one in-ear earbud. Plus I get normal surround sound of the world around me in addition to stereo music. I think it's just one of the best daily-wear inventions yet.
The Pro2 over the Pro1 any day! I'm serious about the extra sound drivers to pump that bass without skull rattling. It's a real comfort boost. You can change it to fully vibration mode in the app, but I've only done that on my Pro2 to show people how bad the Pro1 is lol.
